text:
mira: FYI I opened an RFC for SDK client defaults + streaming ergonomics. Link in PR: github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/142. TL;DR: change retry defaults to be idempotency-aware, standardize on full-jitter backoff, and introduce a StreamingClient that exposes an async iterator + on_partial callback. Need review on acceptance criteria, edge cases, and a rollout plan. Please drop quick thoughts or objections by EOD.

alex: skimmed it. big 👍 for idempotency-first defaults. One request: make explicit how we handle Idempotency-Key headers for non-HTTP transports and how the SDK surfaces that header to users. Many libs expect to provide it.

jon: good point. Also: for backoff we should standardize on full jitter (per aws blog). propose base=100ms, max=10s, factor=2.0. default_max_retries=3 might be better for latency-sensitive paths vs 5. we should expose these as config but keep sane defaults. add metric names: sdk.retry.attempt, sdk.retry.giveup, sdk.retry.backoff_ms.

priya: adding acceptance criteria: 1) unit tests covering cancelled streams and reconnection, 2) integration test that simulates intermittent 502/504 and verifies idempotent requests are retried but non-idempotent are not, 3) memory/regression test to ensure no >1% RSS growth per minute for long-lived streams, 4) clear migration docs for existing customers. Also ensure tracing spans include retry attempts (span attribute sdk.retry.count).

sam: ergonomics nit: async iterator + callback is good, but add a convenience helper to collect whole response (stream_to_string / stream_to_file) for users who want simplicity. example usage in PR would help adoption. also show cancellation api: e.g.

```python
client = StreamingClient(api_key=...)
async for chunk in client.generate_stream(prompt):
    print(chunk.text)
# or cancel
await client.cancel_stream(stream_id)
```

mira: thanks — I’ll add the helper and the cancel snippet. On the Idempotency-Key: proposal is to surface it on RequestOptions and automatically read/set it for HTTP transports, but for gRPC/other transports SDK will pass through a metadata key x-idempotency-key if present. Document will include examples.

ci-bot: PR #142: build/test queued · CI started.

alex: question about default_max_retries: if we pick 3, we should document recommended settings for different workloads (latency-sensitive = 0-2, batch/offline = 5). Also suggest a feature flag/env var REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_POLICY to override defaults without reinstall.

jon: edge-case list to include in RFC: 1) 499 client closed request vs 502 gateway (no retry on 499), 2) idempotency tokens expiring/duplicate suppression at the infra layer, 3) partial stream delivery where final chunk contains status payload (how do we surface final status vs content), 4) interrupted connection mid-KV-cache update — ensure resumed stream doesn't duplicate context.

priya: Launch criteria proposal: docs + migration guide, 50% unit test coverage for new code, end-to-end test matrix (hosted/dedicated/private), opt-in beta for Hosted (2 weeks) with telemetry and health dashboard, no high-sev regressions in that window -> GA. Also add a rollback path (feature flag off on server + SDK fallback).

sam: rollout mechanics: canary on Hosted API first (small tenancy), then opt-in for Dedicated customers via console toggle, then Private customers get SDK patch but require manual enable. communicate breaking changes in SDK changelog and deprecation timeline w/ 8 weeks.

mira: perfect. I will: 1) add the helper API snippets, 2) include config/env var override section, 3) copy jon's edge-case list into RFC, 4) add the acceptance criteria/prioritized test list. Will update PR by tomorrow morning and ping again. thanks all :raised_hands:

ci-bot: PR #142: build passed · tests: 218/218

alex: thanks — sounds good. no objections from me.

jon: no blockers from infra side.

priya: ack, will coordinate the e2e matrix once PR is updated.

mira: closing for now — will reopen thread after PR update.
